scripts.dev:reset: docker compose --profile dev down -v && docker compose --profile dev up --build
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter server start:dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.db:generate: docker compose --profile dev exec server pnpm db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose --profile dev exec server pnpm db:migrate
scripts.db:push: docker compose --profile dev exec server pnpm db:push
scripts.db:studio: docker compose --profile dev exec server pnpm db:studio --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.shell:server: docker compose --profile dev exec server sh
scripts.shell:client: docker compose --profile dev exec client sh
scripts.shell:db: docker compose --profile dev exec postgres psql -U postgres -d appdb
scripts.db:seed: docker compose --profile dev exec server pnpm db:seed
